name: Deep Learning with PyTorch
certifications: No vendor certification; assessed by capstone project
DeepLearning.AI PyTorch for Deep Learning Professional Certificate as a companion

beginner.summary: For Python developers and data scientists starting deep learning. Covers PyTorch set-up and GPUs, tensors, autograd, a linear model from scratch, nn.Module and losses, optimisers and the training loop, datasets and data loaders, GPU training, fully connected and convolutional networks, transfer learning, regularisation, evaluation, checkpoints, recurrent networks, text classification, TensorBoard, debugging training and serving a model behind an API.
prerequisites: Writes Python with functions, classes and NumPy
Knows basic machine learning ideas such as training and test data
outcomes: Build and train neural networks in PyTorch
Prepare data with datasets and data loaders
Train image and text models with transfer learning
Evaluate, debug, save and serve PyTorch models

subtopics: What deep learning is and where PyTorch fits
PyTorch compared with TensorFlow and JAX
Installing PyTorch with CUDA or CPU builds
Jupyter and VS Code for PyTorch work
Google Colab and Kaggle for free GPUs
The PyTorch ecosystem: torchvision, torchaudio and Lightning
Reproducible environments with uv or conda
The course project: a product image classifier
days.lab_task: Install PyTorch locally and in Colab, confirm GPU access, run a tiny model on CPU and GPU, compare the speed and pin the environment for the course.
days.deliverable: Working environment with a pinned requirements file
checks: torch.cuda.is_available returns True on the GPU machine
Same model run on CPU and GPU with timings
objectives: Set up a deep learning environment

days.lab_task: Solve fifteen tensor exercises covering creation, reshaping, broadcasting and matrix multiplication, then fix five planted shape errors.
checks: All fifteen outputs match expected tensors
Data round-trips between NumPy and PyTorch

subtopics: Gradients and why training needs them
days.lab_task: Compute gradients of simple functions with autograd, compare them with hand calculations and numerical estimates, and show gradient accumulation and how to clear it.
checks: Autograd matches hand and numerical gradients

days.topic: Building a Linear Model from Scratch
subtopics: Linear regression as a neural network
days.lab_task: Train a linear regression model from scratch with tensors and manual gradient descent, try three learning rates and compare the result with scikit-learn.
checks: Effect of three learning rates explained
Weights close to the scikit-learn solution

subtopics: Loss functions for regression and classification
days.lab_task: Rebuild the linear model with nn.Module, build a small classifier with nn.Sequential and a custom module, pick the right loss for each and count parameters.
checks: Both models produce outputs of the right shape
Correct loss used for regression and classification

days.lab_task: Write a reusable training loop with training and validation phases, compare SGD and Adam on the same task and log loss and accuracy each epoch.
checks: Training and validation metrics logged each epoch
Model uses train and eval modes correctly

days.lab_task: Write a custom dataset for product images from a CSV, split it, load batches with workers and a weighted sampler for rare classes, and view a sample batch.
checks: Batch tensors have the expected shapes
Rare classes appear more often with the sampler
objectives: Load data with Dataset and DataLoader

subtopics: Moving models and data to the GPU
Speed differences between CPU and GPU
days.lab_task: Make the training code device-agnostic, train on a GPU, find the largest batch size that fits, monitor use with nvidia-smi and fix a device mismatch error.
Train an MLP classifier on Fashion-MNIST and on a tabular dataset, plot confusion matrices and compare the tabular result with a gradient boosting model.
checks: MLP compared with gradient boosting on tabular data

days.lab_task: Build and train a CNN for product images, add batch normalisation, visualise first-layer filters and feature maps and compare accuracy with the MLP.
checks: CNN accuracy higher than the MLP
Training faster or more stable with batch norm

days.lab_task: Fine-tune a pretrained ResNet or EfficientNet on the product images with feature extraction and then full fine-tuning, and compare with the CNN trained from scratch.
checks: Frozen backbone with a new head trains quickly
Transfer learning beats the scratch CNN

days.topic: Regularisation: Dropout, Weight Decay and Early Stopping
days.lab_task: Overfit a model on a small dataset on purpose, then fix it with augmentation, dropout, weight decay and early stopping, and compare validation curves.
checks: Gap between training and validation accuracy shown
Training stops at the best validation epoch

days.lab_task: Evaluate the fine-tuned classifier with per-class precision and recall, PR curves and calibration, analyse the worst errors and write an evaluation report.
checks: Precision and recall shown per class
Patterns in the worst errors described

days.lab_task: Save checkpoints during training, resume after a deliberate stop, keep the best model, load it on CPU and store weights in safetensors format.
checks: Training resumes from the checkpoint with the same metrics
GPU-trained model loads and predicts on CPU
Weights saved and loaded with safetensors

days.lab_task: Classify sensor sequences with an LSTM, handle variable lengths with packing, clip gradients and compare LSTM and GRU accuracy and speed.
Build a review sentiment classifier with an embedding layer, compare random and pretrained embeddings, and evaluate it on a held-out set.
checks: Pretrained embeddings compared with random ones

days.lab_task: Log losses, accuracy, learning rate, sample predictions and weight histograms to TensorBoard for three runs and compare them side by side.
checks: Three runs compared in one view

days.topic: Debugging Training: Shapes, NaNs and Overfitting
days.lab_task: Fix five broken training scripts with problems in shapes, NaNs, learning rate, data leakage and frozen layers, using single-batch overfitting and hooks.
checks: Model reaches near-zero loss on one batch
NaN source found with anomaly detection and fixed

days.topic: Serving a PyTorch Model Behind an API
days.lab_task: Serve the image classifier from a FastAPI service with matching preprocessing, return labels with confidence and model version, containerise it and measure latency.

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Image Classifier from Data to API
days.lab_task: Build a product image classifier end to end: dataset and loaders, transfer learning with regularisation, evaluation and error analysis, checkpoints and a served API, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, evaluation report and running API
checks: Test accuracy meets the agreed target
API returns predictions for new images
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one project
Build a complete deep learning solution

intermediate.summary: For practitioners who already train models in PyTorch. Covers PyTorch Lightning, custom datasets and augmentation, attention and transformers from scratch, fine-tuning with Hugging Face, mixed precision, learning rate schedules, detection and segmentation, torch.compile, experiment tracking, Optuna, distributed data parallel, export with torch.export and ONNX, quantisation and pruning, autoencoders and VAEs, diffusion models, time series, graph neural networks, testing and profiling.
prerequisites: Has trained CNNs or RNNs in PyTorch
Comfortable with training loops, data loaders and GPUs
outcomes: Write clean, scalable PyTorch training code
Speed up, scale and compress models
Build generative, time series and graph models

days.topic: Writing Clean Training Code with PyTorch Lightning
days.lab_task: Move the image classifier into a LightningModule with callbacks, logging, checkpoints and a CLI config, and run it on CPU and GPU with no code changes.
checks: Training runs from a config file
Same code runs on CPU and GPU

subtopics: Datasets for images, text and tables
days.lab_task: Build datasets for images with bounding boxes and for audio, add augmentations including MixUp, stream a large dataset and measure the accuracy gained.
checks: Large dataset trained without loading it all

days.topic: Transformers in PyTorch: Attention from Scratch
days.lab_task: Implement multi-head attention and a small transformer encoder from scratch, check it against PyTorch's built-in attention and train it on a text classification task.
checks: Small transformer beats the LSTM baseline

days.topic: Fine-Tuning Pretrained Models with Hugging Face
days.lab_task: Fine-tune a pretrained text model and a vision transformer with the Trainer API, evaluate them, write model cards and push them to a private Hub repository.
checks: Text model beats the from-scratch baseline
Vision transformer reaches the target accuracy
Models and cards in the private Hub repository

subtopics: Floating point formats: FP32, FP16 and BF16
days.lab_task: Train the classifier in FP32, FP16 with gradient scaling and BF16, and compare speed, memory and accuracy.
checks: Mixed precision run completes without NaNs
Faster training and lower memory recorded

days.topic: Learning Rate Schedules and Optimisation Tricks
days.lab_task: Find a good learning rate, compare constant, cosine with warm-up and one-cycle schedules, add gradient accumulation and weight averaging and pick the best recipe.
checks: Learning rate finder plot used to choose a value
Schedules compared on accuracy and time
Effective batch size increased without more memory

subtopics: Faster R-CNN and modern detectors in torchvision
Fine-tuning a detector on custom data
days.lab_task: Fine-tune a torchvision detector on a small custom dataset of shelf products, compute mAP and train a segmentation model for product masks.
days.deliverable: Detection and segmentation models with metrics
checks: Detector finds products with the target mAP
Masks match products on test images
IoU and mAP explained with examples

subtopics: Using compile in training and inference
days.lab_task: Compile the training and inference code, find and remove graph breaks, compare compile modes and record speed-ups and compile time.
checks: Modes compared on speed and compile time

days.topic: Tracking PyTorch Experiments with Weights & Biases and MLflow
days.lab_task: Track twenty training runs in Weights & Biases and MLflow with configs, metrics and artefacts, compare them and register the best model.
checks: Best run identified from tracked metrics
Best run reproduced from its logged config

days.lab_task: Search learning rate, batch size, dropout and architecture size with Optuna, prune weak trials, compare with the hand-tuned recipe and check on a held-out test set.
checks: Best trial beats the hand-tuned recipe
Gain holds on the held-out test set

days.topic: Multi-GPU Training with Distributed Data Parallel
subtopics: Batch size and learning rate scaling
days.lab_task: Convert the training script to DistributedDataParallel, run it with torchrun on two or more GPUs, scale batch size and learning rate and compare speed.
checks: Accuracy holds after scaling batch size and learning rate

days.topic: Exporting Models: TorchScript, ONNX and torch.export
subtopics: Running ONNX models with ONNX Runtime
days.lab_task: Export the classifier with torch.export and to ONNX, run it with ONNX Runtime, check outputs match PyTorch and compare inference speed.
checks: ONNX model runs in ONNX Runtime

days.lab_task: Quantise and prune the classifier, distil it into a smaller student and compare size, latency and accuracy for each option.
checks: Model size reduced with acceptable accuracy
Student model close to the teacher's accuracy

days.lab_task: Train a denoising autoencoder and a VAE on product images, explore the latent space, generate new samples and use reconstruction error to spot anomalies.
checks: Noisy images cleaned by the autoencoder
VAE samples look like the training data
Anomalous images get high reconstruction error

days.lab_task: Train a small diffusion model on simple images, generate samples, run a pretrained text-to-image pipeline and fine-tune it with LoRA on a few product photos.
checks: Pretrained pipeline produces images from prompts
Fine-tuned model shows the product style

days.topic: Time Series Forecasting with Deep Learning
days.lab_task: Forecast store demand with an LSTM and a transformer forecaster, backtest them against a seasonal baseline and produce prediction intervals.
checks: Deep model beats the seasonal baseline

days.topic: Graph Neural Networks with PyTorch Geometric
subtopics: Use cases in fraud and recommendations
days.lab_task: Train a GCN for node classification and a GraphSAGE model for link prediction on a transactions graph, and compare with a non-graph baseline.
checks: Neighbour sampling trains on a large graph

days.topic: Testing and Reproducibility for Training Code
subtopics: Unit tests for models and data
days.lab_task: Add tests for data, model shapes, gradients and a small overfitting test, control seeds, manage configs with Hydra, version data with DVC and run tests in CI.
checks: Model and data tests pass in CI
Same seed and config give the same metrics
Data version tied to each run

days.lab_task: Profile a slow training run, find data loading and kernel bottlenecks, fix them and show higher GPU use and shorter epochs.
checks: Main bottleneck identified in the profile

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Fine-Tuned Vision Transformer Service
days.lab_task: Fine-tune a vision transformer with augmentation, mixed precision and tuned hyperparameters, track experiments, quantise and export it, serve it and report results.
checks: Exported model meets the latency target
Final run reproducible from tracked config
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one project
Ship an optimised deep learning model

advanced.summary: For senior ML engineers and researchers. Covers PyTorch internals, custom operators and Triton kernels, FSDP and large model training, training small language models, LoRA and QLoRA, LLM inference optimisation with vLLM, cluster training with Ray or Kubernetes, memory optimisation, mixture-of-experts and model parallelism, advanced compilation, ExecuTorch, RLHF concepts and DPO, multimodal models, evaluation at scale, data pipelines, reproducible research, cost and carbon, distributed debugging and leading deep learning projects.
prerequisites: Several years training deep learning models in PyTorch
Strong Python, linear algebra and GPU knowledge
Has trained models on multiple GPUs
outcomes: Train and serve large models efficiently
Extend PyTorch with custom kernels and compilation
Scale training on clusters and debug distributed jobs
Lead deep learning projects with sound evaluation

days.topic: PyTorch Internals: Tensors, Dispatcher and Autograd Engine
subtopics: How autograd records and replays operations
days.lab_task: Explore strides and views, write a custom autograd function with a hand-written backward, inspect the caching allocator and explain an asynchronous timing mistake.
checks: View and copy behaviour explained with strides
Correct GPU timing with synchronisation shown

days.topic: Writing Custom Operators and CUDA Kernels with Triton
subtopics: When custom kernels are worth it
days.lab_task: Write a fused Triton kernel for a layer-norm or activation pattern, register it as a custom operator with autograd, test correctness and benchmark against PyTorch.
days.deliverable: Custom operator with tests and benchmarks
checks: Speed-up over the PyTorch version recorded
Operator works inside a compiled model

days.topic: Fully Sharded Data Parallel and Large Model Training
subtopics: Sharding parameters, gradients and optimiser state
days.lab_task: Train a model too large for one GPU with FSDP, tune wrapping and precision, save and reload sharded checkpoints and compare memory with DDP.
checks: Model trains across GPUs that could not hold it alone

days.topic: Training Language Models from Scratch at Small Scale
days.lab_task: Train a tokeniser and a small decoder-only language model on a domain corpus, track perplexity, try sampling strategies and write lessons for scaling up.
days.deliverable: Small language model and training report

days.topic: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning in PyTorch with LoRA, QLoRA and PEFT
days.lab_task: Fine-tune an open language model with LoRA and QLoRA on a support dataset, compare memory and quality, merge an adapter and evaluate against the base model.
checks: QLoRA run fits on a single GPU
Fine-tuned model beats the base on the evaluation set
Merged model gives the same outputs

days.topic: Inference Optimisation for LLMs: KV Caching, Batching and vLLM
days.lab_task: Serve a language model with plain PyTorch and with vLLM, add quantisation and continuous batching, and compare tokens per second and latency under load.
checks: vLLM throughput compared with plain PyTorch
Quantised model faster with acceptable quality
Latency measured at three concurrency levels

days.topic: Distributed Training on Clusters with Ray or Kubernetes
days.lab_task: Run a multi-node training job with Ray Train or a Kubernetes training operator, survive a node failure with checkpoints and track cost per run.
checks: Training resumes after a node is lost

days.topic: Memory Optimisation: Activation Checkpointing and Offloading
days.lab_task: Profile memory for a long-sequence model, apply activation checkpointing, offloading and 8-bit optimisers, and chart memory against speed.
checks: Memory use broken down by type
Peak memory reduced with each technique
Speed cost of each technique recorded

days.lab_task: Add a mixture-of-experts layer to a small transformer, measure routing balance, run tensor parallelism across two GPUs and compare communication costs.
checks: Load balancing loss keeps experts used
Model runs split across two GPUs

days.lab_task: Compile a distributed training job, reduce recompilations caused by guards, use regional compilation to cut compile time and enable CUDA graphs for inference.
checks: Inference latency lower with CUDA graphs

days.lab_task: Export a small vision model with ExecuTorch, quantise it, run it in a sample mobile app and measure latency and memory on a phone.
checks: Model predicts in the mobile app
Quantised model smaller with acceptable accuracy

days.topic: Preference Tuning: RLHF Concepts and Direct Preference Optimisation
subtopics: RLHF with PPO at a high level
days.lab_task: Fine-tune a small instruction model with DPO on a preference dataset, compare responses before and after with human and automatic judgements and discuss limits.
checks: Preferred responses chosen more often after tuning
Risks and limits of the approach written

days.lab_task: Build image-text search over a product catalogue with a CLIP model, fine-tune it on product captions and evaluate retrieval before and after.
checks: Relevant product images returned for text queries

days.topic: Evaluation at Scale for Deep Learning Models
days.lab_task: Build an evaluation suite with slices, out-of-distribution sets and robustness tests, run language model benchmarks with a harness and report results with confidence intervals.
Build a sharded, deduplicated and filtered training dataset in object storage, stream it at full GPU speed and record provenance for every shard.
checks: Every shard traced to its sources

days.lab_task: Run an ablation study of three model changes across five seeds, compare results statistically and write a short research note with released code.
checks: Each change tested across five seeds
Results reproducible from the released code

days.topic: Cost and Carbon Efficiency in Training
days.lab_task: Measure cost and carbon for a training run, cut both with better utilisation, spot instances and a more efficient recipe, and report the savings.
checks: Cost and carbon per run recorded
Cost reduced with the same accuracy

days.lab_task: Diagnose four broken distributed jobs: a hang, an NCCL error, a straggler and a divergence, fix each and write a runbook.
Plan a deep learning project from problem framing to production with data strategy, build or fine-tune decision, milestones, risks and a responsible AI review, and present it.
checks: Success metric tied to business value
Decision justified with cost and risk

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Domain LLM Fine-Tuning and Serving Platform
days.lab_task: Build a domain language model system with a curated dataset, efficient fine-tuning at scale, preference tuning, rigorous evaluation and optimised serving, then defend it to a review panel.
days.deliverable: Model, evaluation report, serving setup and defence
checks: Model beats the base on the domain evaluation
Serving meets throughput and latency targets
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one project
